_comment: Pinned library set for the HosterPK template. This file is the FINAL authority for versions/SHA/SRI; docs only point here. Alpine + HTMX are vendored as files under js/vendor/ and their on-disk SHA-256 matches the pin below. Bootstrap is the compatibility target / own-bundle pin (not vendored as a file in the scaffold stub; Story 2.2 owns the BS5 bundle). Bootstrap Icons is the icon SOURCE consumed into the brand sprite. The Story 1.9 theme-guard beacon checks these SHAs for drift.

core.name: Blesta
core._comment: The core beta tag the template + Story 1.8 stock-view baseline were mirrored against. The Story 1.9 beacon flags drift when live BLESTA_VERSION differs. Bump this (and re-run ./tooling/check.sh baseline <tag>) after a beta re-apply - see FOUNDATION.md section 0. Has no sha256/vendored_file key on purpose: check.sh RULE 4 must not try to hash it.

libraries.name: Bootstrap
libraries.role: compatibility-target / own-bundle pin (NOT vendored as a file — architecture rejects a ~200KB second framework). Story 2.2 dropped stock application.min.css and shipped our own bundle (tokens + base.css frame-tier floor); the shareable BS4->BS5 class surface is re-provided by authored CSS + the 33-class shim (Story 2.9)

libraries.name: Bootstrap Icons
libraries.role: icon SOURCE consumed into the brand sprite (currentColor only)

brand_bundle.name: hpk-brand
brand_bundle._comment: Cross-app contract: the brand-bundle version + per-asset SHAs this template consumed (dist + fonts[] + icons[] sprite). Must match brand/versions.json. The Story 1.9 beacon re-hashes these served assets for drift.
